title: Import
description: Bring your team's history over from another helpdesk or a CSV file: every ticket with its whole conversation, the people who wrote in, and your help center.

pick.title: Where is your history now?
pick.hint: Connect the account you use today. Nothing changes there, and you can keep working in it until you switch.
pick.oneAtATime: One import runs at a time. Start another when this one is done.

quiet.title: Quiet.
quiet.body: No customer gets an email, and automations, SLA timers, webhooks and notifications stay still for imported tickets.

people.title: Your people, mapped.
people.body: Agents become members and groups become teams, matched by email and name. You check every match before it starts.

undo.title: Undo any time.
undo.body: One click takes out what an import brought, and leaves alone what your team wrote since.

zendesk.blurb: Tickets with replies and notes, users, organizations and Guide articles.

helpscout.blurb: Conversations from every mailbox, customers, and your Docs articles.

freshdesk.blurb: Tickets with replies and notes, contacts, companies and solution articles.

intercom.blurb: Conversations with notes and files, contacts, companies and articles.

front.blurb: Conversations from every shared inbox, with comments, files and contacts.

csv.blurb: An export from any other helpdesk, one row per ticket or per message.

wizard.title: Import from {{name}}
wizard.description: Connect your {{name}} account. We read from it and never change anything there.
wizard.csvDescription: Upload an export from your current helpdesk, then tell us which column holds what.

facts.conversations: Every ticket with all its replies, notes and attachments, at their original dates.
facts.people: Customers and companies, agents as members and groups as teams.
facts.quiet: Nobody is emailed and no automation runs.

wizard.startedToast: Import started. You can leave this page, we'll let you know when it's done.
wizard.leaveBody: Nothing has been imported yet. Your choices here will be lost.

connect.safety: Read only. Your credentials are encrypted and used only to read {{name}}. They are removed 30 days after the last run, or whenever you choose.

review.noSamples: No tickets to preview yet. The import will still bring what it finds.
review.agentsHint: Their replies, notes and tickets go to the member you choose. Anyone left out keeps their name on what they wrote.
review.groupsHint: Tickets of each group go to the team you choose.

csv.drop: Drop your CSV file here, or click to choose one
csv.dropHint: One row per ticket, or one row per message with a ticket id so we can group them. A header row names the columns.
csv.formats: UTF-8 or UTF-16, separated by commas, semicolons or tabs. Up to 50 MB and 500,000 rows.
csv.tooLarge: That file is over 50 MB. Split it into smaller files and import them one after another.
csv.wrongType: Choose a .csv file. Spreadsheets can save one with File, then Download or Export, as CSV.
csv.emptyColumn: This column is empty in the first rows
csv.needBody: Choose the column with the message, or at least the subject.
csv.grouping: Rows with the same ticket id become one ticket, with each row as a message in time order. Without a ticket id column, every row is its own ticket.

team.label: Team
team.hint: Matched to a team by name

message_id.label: Message-ID
message_id.hint: The email's own id, so replies thread

options.articlesHint_one: {{n}} article with its collection. Images come too.
options.articlesHint_other: {{n}} articles with their collections. Images come too.
options.articlesNone: This account has no help center to bring.
options.articlesNoDocs: Add a Docs API key in the first step to bring your Docs articles.
options.draftsHint: Look them over before they go live on your help center.
options.attachmentsHint: Files up to 25 MB each. Leave off for a faster import.
options.sinceHint: Older tickets stay behind. Articles always come whole.
options.keepHint: Open tickets arrive open and land in your queues.
options.closedHint: Everything arrives closed, so your queues stay as they are.
options.label: Label
options.labelHint: Added to every imported ticket, so you can find them.
options.mailboxHint: Replies to imported email tickets go out from this mailbox.

summary.quiet: Nobody is emailed, and automations, SLA timers and webhooks stay still.
summary.after: Large accounts take a while. It runs on our side, so you can close this page. We'll let you know when it's done, and you can bring over what changed since at any time.

current.runningHint: Updates live. You can leave this page and come back.

progress.undoing: Taking out what the import brought
progress.paused: Paused. It goes on from here when you resume.
progress.waiting: {{name}} asked us to slow down. Going on in {{seconds}}s.
progress.cancelBody: What already came over stays. Its credentials are removed, and you can undo it later.
progress.undoBody_one: This takes out the {{tickets}} ticket and {{articles}} articles it brought, with the contacts, companies and labels nothing else uses. Tickets your team has written on since stay.
progress.undoBody_other: This takes out the {{tickets}} tickets and {{articles}} articles it brought, with the contacts, companies and labels nothing else uses. Tickets your team has written on since stay.
progress.undoneHint: Undone. What this import brought has been taken out.
progress.forgetBody: The import can no longer bring over changes from {{name}}. What came over stays.
progress.failedHint: What came over stays. Try again to go on from where it stopped.
progress.kept: Credentials are kept so you can bring over changes until you switch. They are removed 30 days after the last run.

history.title: Earlier imports
history.hint: Open one to bring over changes, undo it or see what it could not bring.
